semantics.clock: All sequential logic samples on positive clk edges, per original text.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset clears packet progress and done at the sampling edge; incomplete packets are discarded.
semantics.acceptance: Every non-reset rising edge consumes one byte. While searching, discard bytes with bit 3 zero; a byte with bit 3 one starts a packet. Consume the next two bytes unconditionally.
semantics.completion: After the edge consuming the third byte, done is high for one cycle and out_bytes contains that packet. The following edge may accept a new first byte without a bubble.
semantics.waveform_evidence: The displayed input changes at rising-edge timestamps are applied after sampling: 2c at 15 ns is consumed at 25 ns, 81 at 35 ns, 09 at 45 ns, when done becomes 1. 6b is consumed at 55 ns and its packet completes at 75 ns.
semantics.initialization: No initial values are required before the first synchronous reset. Example shows done and out_bytes unknown at 0 ns. Payload outside done is don't-care.

verification.oracle: Independent byte count and packet assembly from original algorithm
verification.cases: Exact waveform timestamp replay; discarded bytes; arbitrary second/third bytes; contiguous packets; reset at all progress positions; all 256 possible search bytes; deterministic randomized streams
verification.sampling: Check after NBA updates and again at falling edges

specification_ambiguities.issue: Waveform input updates coincide with rising edges, without delta-cycle notation
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Treat displayed inputs as post-edge values. Sampling previous stable inputs matches every listed done and payload.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Initial payload and payload outside done are unconstrained
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not check payload outside done or demand initial values; RTL uses no initialization.
